title: Source-level proof locators for the three-task cohomology edition
scope: Numbered proof identifiers in included Markdown headings and TeX-only source headings. The cumulative Markdown duplicates and TeX counterparts of included Markdown are omitted. A historical or review heading is searchable without being promoted to a newly verified theorem.
locator_convention: One-based source lines; heading text is retained exactly apart from TeX whitespace. The declared ID is a leading section label. Other IDs in a heading are references, not automatic declarations. An ID can have more than one source occurrence; no duplicate is silently resolved.
